def.brief: Narrow non-author review of d1e8c32 (path_diff keeps only each kept path's own section) by a fresh Claude sub-agent: it opens Q-exact-sections, path_diff and the test_Q_exact_sections_* tests itself and probes quoted names, a target inside a larger repository, diff.noprefix/diff.mnemonicPrefix configs and file/directory changes on real temporary git repositories; it changes no files. xs-build's accepting re-verification opened no file (recorded non-claim); that verdict stays as recorded.

non-claims: no check decides this task; done means the agent said so
xs-review: done on the session's word by name (`run xs-review`), with nothing of its own in the tree and no `did`
xs-review: done by the session's sub-agent — chongdae saw the session and the tree, not the sub-agent; its model is the session's unless the session dispatched it with another
